description: NUTBUSTER cross-platform implementation and verification ledger. Status describes code coverage, NOT real-device certification.

features.name: Authored campaign stages, replay and progression
features.gap: Native scripted stage mechanics and final progression/save parity remain incomplete.

features.name: Match-three swaps, board goals and gravity
features.gap: Later-stage blockers, specials, transport, combo effects and per-turn differential replay remain incomplete.

features.name: Ice, locks, chests, jam and tile overlays
features.gap: Only a subset of original damage and movement/overlay effects runs natively.

features.name: Boosters, held nut effects, combo specials
features.gap: Butter/Jam held-nut simulation and JS parity fixtures implemented; no native booster inventory, user interaction, approved icon, shop, other boosters or special-combo parity yet.

features.name: Elemental powers, trial stages and rewards
features.gap: Port trial unlock flow, power resolution and elemental rewards.

features.name: Nutvale mining, seeded ore and rewards
features.gap: Native mining input exists but mobile progression/save and wider minigame parity are incomplete.

features.name: Mining equipment and 40-tier approved artwork
features.gap: Full UI, earned-currency integration and mobile save migration remain incomplete.

features.name: Homestead and house/renovation systems
features.gap: Native Homestead scenes, controls, inventory and progression are absent.

features.name: Fishing, rods, catches and Wharf
features.gap: Native fishing, Wharf and upgrades are absent.

features.name: Shop bundles, random payouts and currency economy
features.gap: Native shops, paid-style free checkout, randomness and booster economy are absent.

features.name: Daily rewards, promo codes and persistence
features.gap: Native preview saves progress and mine only; no mobile save import, promo or full account reset.

features.name: Sound, music and announcer playback
features.gap: No native audio engine wired to gameplay yet.

features.name: Signed updater, platform-safe release packaging
features.gap: Android signed updater exists; native desktop updater, installers and parity release gate are pending.

features.name: Companions, avatar art and customization
features.gap: Native companion models, avatar selection, wardrobe and home display are absent.

features.name: Voluntary parody ads and earned rewards
features.gap: Native ad-style reward scene and its free payout logic are absent.

features.name: Game feedback effects and HUD transitions
features.gap: Native direct-rendered effects and timed HUD feedback have not been ported.

features.name: User-invoked invites, share and platform integrations
features.gap: Native desktop sharing and optional invitations are not implemented.

features.name: Nutdex, authored icon identity and guides
features.gap: Native Nutdex encyclopedia, entries and icon-to-mechanic navigation are absent.

features.name: Nutvale authored economy art and item display
features.gap: Native economy item illustrations and fully matching catalog presentation are incomplete.

targetImpact.android: Removed obsolete coming-soon promotional image from shared mobile home menu; unrelated release ticker and actions stay intact.
targetImpact.fire_os: Uses the exact same mobile home menu and signed APK as Android, so the retired promotion is removed identically.
targetImpact.windows: Independent native SDL3 Menu scene has no Rupee Rush image or promotion to remove; native gameplay parity remains preview-partial.
targetImpact.linux: Independent native SDL3 Menu scene has no Rupee Rush image or promotion to remove; native gameplay parity remains preview-partial.

presentationChangeReviews.decision: Presentation-only retirement; no native gameplay code change or feature-coverage upgrade is justified. Keep native preview parity gates and known gaps unchanged.

targetImpact.android: Approved Jewel Brook wide campaign banner renders from locally packaged WebP and opens the verified Jewel_Brook GitHub releases index in an external browser through a fixed allowlisted Java bridge.
targetImpact.fire_os: Identical signed Android APK uses the same locally packaged banner and fixed Java external-browser intent; physical Fire OS device testing remains pending.
targetImpact.windows: Independent native SDL3 preview does not yet have cross-promotion banner UI or external URL action; its existing feature gaps and preview-only status remain unchanged.
targetImpact.linux: Independent native SDL3 preview does not yet have cross-promotion banner UI or external URL action; its existing feature gaps and preview-only status remain unchanged.

presentationChangeReviews.decision: Cross-promotional presentation change on the shared mobile home screen only; explicitly account for the unimplemented native preview banner rather than silently claiming four-target feature parity.

targetImpact.android: Android WebView board can retain nut-exploding CSS animation-fill-mode:forwards (opacity zero) after a canceled cascade; completed-resolution reconciliation now clears stale shake/explosion classes without rebuilding tiles or altering nut payloads.
targetImpact.fire_os: Same signed Android WebView APK and DOM/CSS as Android; identical stale-animation cleanup. Physical Fire OS acceptance is not claimed.
targetImpact.windows: Native C++17/SDL3 renderer does not use the WebView DOM, CSS animation classes, or .nut-visual; no corresponding C++ change is applicable. Existing native gameplay parity remains preview-partial.
targetImpact.linux: Native C++17/SDL3 renderer likewise does not use DOM/CSS animation classes; no corresponding C++ change is applicable. Existing native gameplay parity remains preview-partial.

presentationChangeReviews.decision: Presentation-only cleanup of canceled mobile CSS animation state; functional UI regression verifies stale opacity class removal. No match-three rule, save format, native SDL3 render path, signing identity or native feature status changes. Actual Android device reproduction and approval remain outstanding under issue #1.
